package.description: A cross-platform terminal app for discovering and managing Git repositories

en-US.description: A cross-platform terminal app for discovering and managing Git repositories
en-US.longDescription:
Git Repository Manager scans directories to find Git repositories and displays them in an interactive terminal UI.
Features include viewing branch status, syncing repos, switching branches, and opening in VS Code or terminal.
en-US.name: Git Repository Manager
